assertions.assertion: Malformed/null inventory preserves prior installed observations; interrupted operations become uncertain without replay.

assertions.anchor: func TestPluginMaintenanceCannotRaceStartsOrAcceptInjectedArguments(
assertions.assertion: Management cannot race start/message/answer or active work; malformed selectors and credential-bearing sources reject without creating a worktree.

assertions.anchor: func TestSelectedDiscoveredSkillKeepsItsBundleAndAutomaticChecksDoNotInstall(
assertions.assertion: Discovery and launch preserve skill text/support files/executable modes; scheduled checks refresh metadata without an install command.

assertions.anchor: func TestReviewPolicyInheritancePromptAndExactlyOnceAutomaticStart(
assertions.assertion: System defaults queue; enabled inherited policy starts one pinned read-only review with appended repo text, survives duplicate polls/restart and accepts a new request episode.

assertions.anchor: func TestRepositoryQueueOverridePauseDraftAndStaleRequestsDoNotStart(
assertions.assertion: Queue override, pause, draft, old sync, absent request, sync error and unsafe review profile cannot launch automatically.

assertions.anchor: TestDashboardSummariesOmitHistoryAndKeepFullItemDetail
assertions.assertion: Dashboard size stays below 30KB with megabyte activity/check fixtures, preserving reviewer membership/body/head/revision; full read_item content is intact.

assertions.anchor: review queues from multiple repositories load full details from compact snapshots
assertions.assertion: Both narrow themes display requested PRs from two repositories with compact summaries, read only the selected detail and retain full checks/activity without launching.

assertions.anchor: TestGitHubSharedBudgetSurvivesRestartSerializesAndFailsClosed
assertions.assertion: Concurrent requests share a serialized rolling budget, restart cannot reset the count, expiry permits later work, and unavailable accounting sends no request.

assertions.anchor: TestGitHubPersistentConditionalCacheAuthIsolationAnd304RateObservation
assertions.assertion: Persisted conditional responses retain body/pagination, fresh 304 quota headers protect the reserve, different credentials do not inherit cache/limits, and cookies/raw tokens are excluded.

assertions.anchor: TestNotificationReviewHintsAreScopedReadOnlyAndRestartSafe
assertions.assertion: GET notifications includes read threads, only configured repositories receive targeted PR reads, repeated events do not refetch unchanged PRs, cadence/cursor survive calls, failed batches retain the cursor and queue-only starts no agent.

assertions.anchor: TestIndexCallCountDoesNotGrowWithPRHistory
assertions.assertion: One hundred open requested PRs import with two repository listing calls and no per-PR enrichment fan-out.

assertions.anchor: GitHub usage settings show cached quota and save budget without polling
assertions.assertion: Both narrow themes display cached quota and save request budget/reserve/notification interval without polling repositories, reading item details or starting work; scoped accessibility and overflow assertions apply.

assertions.anchor: a deferred detail refresh retains saved information and unread state until a successful retry
assertions.assertion: Deferred detail refresh shows saved content and an explicit Retry; it does not mark the revision read until a successful retry, and never prepares or starts an agent.

assertions.anchor: linked PR changes refresh full selected details without consuming another read or launch
assertions.assertion: A linked PR metadata change rereads full selected detail and displays latest checks without marking the item read again or launching work.

assertions.anchor: TestDiagnosticsUseLocalGitHubCredentialAndRespectReconciliationCadence
assertions.assertion: Diagnostics perform only local GitHub credential lookup, expose no credential value, accept recent periodic reconciliation and distinguish paused/deferred monitoring from failure.

assertions.anchor: Markdown issue headings do not replace the useful conversation summary
assertions.assertion: Conversation summary skips consecutive Markdown-only heading paragraphs, shows meaningful issue text, retains the original full description and never prepares/starts work.

assertions.anchor: fresh read markers observe external changes after a host memoizes an empty journal page
assertions.assertion: A host memoizes identical snapshot/journal arguments; after an empty journal reply, two external updates appear automatically, using distinct read markers and no launch/message mutation.

assertions.anchor: explicit full-access launch shows never approvals and authorized publishing
assertions.assertion: Prepared launch visibly retains full-access/never/authorized authority, starts only on explicit Start, and Settings explains that automatic reviews use the selected authority.

assertions.anchor: func TestPostedReviewsRefreshAfterTurnAndRetainReceiptsOnFailure(
assertions.assertion: Completed PR turns refresh actual GitHub receipts; repeated reads respect cadence; failure and pause retain successful receipts and freshness; issues reject.

assertions.anchor: func TestPublishedReviewsKeepVerdictCommitAndPaginatedInlineEvidence(
assertions.assertion: Read-only authenticated pagination preserves verdict, author, commit, body and correctly grouped inline comments; pending drafts are excluded.

assertions.anchor: posted reviews show verified verdicts findings and refresh after completion
assertions.assertion: Both narrow themes expose receipts/verdicts/current or earlier commits/body/inline comments, unverified and stale states; snapshot version refresh, host links and manual refresh launch no work; scoped Axe passes.

assertions.anchor: TestStartupContinuesPendingSessionFromRetainedProgress
assertions.assertion: Startup continues pending running/queued/starting/interrupted work through the same thread, retains workspace/profile/prompt and completed reviewer artifacts, and a repeated recovery does not create another session or replay the original task.

assertions.anchor: terminated work retains history and cleanup without allowing continuation
assertions.assertion: In both themes, terminated work shows Stopped and its lifecycle reason, disables message continuation, exposes cleanup, omits Interrupt and sends no start or message action.

assertions.anchor: saved details and receipts render during background refresh
assertions.assertion: Both themes show saved details/receipts and pending feedback immediately, then automatically reread without launching work; receipt reads carry distinct freshness markers and scoped Axe passes.

assertions.anchor: saved message clears its draft before agent delivery and shows uncertainty without replay
assertions.assertion: A durable accepted queue receipt clears only the submitted draft before activation; queued delivery is visible, replaced by uncertainty under the same message ID, and sends/starts are never replayed.

assertions.anchor: func TestManualPRReviewRejectsOwnPullRequests(
assertions.assertion: Dedicated/generic review preparation rejects own PRs and missing author/identity before a durable proposal; other work stays available.

assertions.anchor: func TestManualPRReviewRechecksAuthorBeforeStart(
assertions.assertion: Start rejects prepared and legacy own-author reviews without creating state events or a workspace.

assertions.anchor: own PR review rejection preserves the first message without starting
assertions.assertion: Both themes display the own-PR rejection, retain the editable first message and send no Start or create any run.

assertions.anchor: func TestDeliveredMessageReconcilesOnlyAcknowledgedQuestions(
assertions.assertion: Delivered same-run acknowledged decisions retire only resolved questions; remaining IDs stay answerable, unrelated follow-ups preserve questions and completed acknowledgements clear actionable attention.

assertions.anchor: func TestGitHubCacheExpiryInvalidationLiveWriteThroughAndRestart(
assertions.assertion: Ordinary queries reuse persisted successful data; expiry, invalidation and live mode refresh it without crossing endpoint/principal scope.
